items.stem: In Business Central, which object lets you load master and setup data in bulk when creating a new company?

options.rationale: Correct: configuration packages import setup and master data in bulk via Excel/RapidStart.
Dimension values categorize entries; they do not import data in bulk.
Permission sets grant access rights, not data import.
Number series assign document numbers; they do not load data.

items.explanation: Correct: configuration packages import setup and master data in bulk via Excel/RapidStart.

items.stem: Which setup tells Business Central which general ledger accounts to use when posting a sale between a customer group and an item group?

options.rationale: Correct: the general posting setup maps business/product posting groups to G/L accounts.
Number series assign document numbers, not G/L accounts.
Dimensions tag entries for analysis; they do not map posting accounts.
Payment terms set due dates, not posting accounts.

items.explanation: Correct: the general posting setup maps business/product posting groups to G/L accounts.

items.stem: Which TWO steps are part of processing a purchase from a vendor in Business Central? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Receive items against the purchase order
options.rationale: Correct: receiving records the goods received for the order.

options.text: Post a purchase invoice from the order
options.rationale: Correct: posting the invoice records the vendor liability and cost.
Sensitivity labels are a Microsoft Purview feature, not a BC purchase step.
Conditional Access is an identity control, unrelated to purchasing.
Planning Optimization is a Supply Chain Management (MB-330) feature, not BC purchasing.

items.explanation: Correct: receiving records the goods received for the order. Correct: posting the invoice records the vendor liability and cost.
